properties.name: WESTERN MARITIME ALLIANCE (US / NATO / G7)
properties.description: Blue-water naval dominance, USD reserve currency, international law enforcement, advanced semiconductor IP.
properties.friction: South China Sea navigation, Taiwan Strait, Ukraine frontier.

properties.name: EURASIAN CONTINENTAL BLOC (Russia / Central Asia)
properties.description: Vast territorial depth, hydrocarbon export, buffer state security, strategic nuclear parity.
properties.friction: Eastern European border, NATO expansion, Central Asian influence.

properties.name: SINIC INDUSTRIAL CAPACITY (China / Belt & Road)
properties.description: Manufacturing supremacy, critical rare-earth processing, infrastructure export, state-directed capitalism.
properties.friction: Taiwan Strait, Nine-Dash Line claim vs ASEAN, US chip export bans.

properties.name: INDO-PACIFIC DEMOCRATIC CORE (India / Subcontinent)
properties.description: Demographic scale, strategic non-alignment, software & pharma export, Indian Ocean security.
properties.friction: Himalayan border with China, Malacca Strait maritime balance.

properties.name: MIDDLE EAST ENERGY & ISLAMIC HUB (GCC / Iran / MENA)
properties.description: Hydrocarbon reserves, sovereign wealth fund capital, global Islamic cultural leadership, maritime chokepoints.
properties.friction: Red Sea shipping safety, Sunni-Shia regional proxy friction.

properties.name: GLOBAL SOUTH & CRITICAL MINERALS (Africa / LATAM)
properties.description: Energy-transition raw materials (Lithium, Cobalt, Copper), massive youth demographic, post-colonial voting block.
properties.friction: Value-chain extraction vs local refining, BRI debt restructuring.

properties.name: NUSANTARA ARCHIPELAGIC STRAIT PIVOT (Malaysia / Indonesia / SEA)
properties.description: The Crossroads: Control over Malacca, Sunda, and Lombok straits. Refracts global trade without taking military sides.
properties.friction: South China Sea EEZ encroachment, US-China dual dependency.

properties.name: Strait of Malacca (Malaysia / Indonesia / Singapore)
properties.significance: ~30% of global trade and 80% of China's oil imports pass through this 1.7nm narrow funnel.

properties.name: Taiwan Strait
properties.significance: Primary semiconductor choke and key naval corridor connecting East and South China Seas.

properties.name: Strait of Hormuz (Oman / Iran)
properties.significance: World's most critical oil transit chokepoint (~21 million barrels/day).

properties.name: Bab-el-Mandeb & Red Sea (Yemen / Djibouti)
properties.significance: Connects Indian Ocean to Suez Canal; critical maritime energy & container shipping lane.

properties.name: Sunda & Lombok Straits (Indonesia)
properties.significance: Deepwater alternative to Malacca for supertankers and military submarine transit.
